title: Why Supermarkets Play Slow Music
mechanism: Slow background music slows shoppers down and fast music hurries them out, so stores pick tempo (and even style) to steer how long you stay and what you buy.

beats.hook: You came in for one carton of milk
beats.story: Twenty minutes later your cart is full
beats.rise: You feel calm; you even grabbed French wine
beats.twist: A back door swings open: the manager is turning a TEMPO dial
beats.mechanism: TEMPO dial SLOW/FAST, metronomes 72 BPM / 92 BPM, sales screen +38%, wine shelf with FRANCE/GERMANY speakers, signs 77% FRENCH / 73% GERMAN, clipboard 1 OF 44
beats.ending: Checkout with forty things and no milk; in aisle nine the dial turns slower

seed.what: The ceiling speaker and the STAFF ONLY door at the back of the aisle

locations.set: Room golden + aisle shelves + ceiling speaker
Room neon + wine shelves + flag speakers

characters.look: white shirt, tie colour lanyard, headphones

gags.what: The overloaded cart tips and a cereal box avalanche follows
With fast music, shoppers race past and one spins out on the floor
Forty items roll down the checkout belt; the milk is not among them
